title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 2abe0263c6e9… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 2abe0263c6e96f13d2f53f36e29c4210006ef841f4382eee40ae985443abedc9 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. This file was detected three times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in the Netherlands. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to detect potential compromise.
